source_reasoning: Old RC1 SSD boot init sends legacy geometry operation0.
New firmware rejects op0 without USB submission or PIO data exchange, latches only USB bridge fault, and publishes completed CMDERROR.
Old kernel sets failed=true and ssd_initialized=false, then clears only its completed command error through CMD_Reset.
CMD_Reset restores shared PM READY; it does not clear the USB bridge fault. BIOS internal-SD and SD FatFs paths are unchanged.
Interim old-kernel/new-firmware boot is solely for internal-SD installation; USB service is expected unavailable.
procedure: Keep USB storage disconnected for first boot; boot internal SD normally after verified firmware flash.
Verify running old RC1/root-only state and staged kernel/recovery hashes, then perform separately authorized new-kernel installation and exact readback.
Use separately authorized shutdown; user must fully power OFF both PPC/PicoMEM with USB-C disconnected before starting the matching pair.
Do not attempt USB mounts/probes/tests during the interim boot; do not treat a warm reboot as clearing the bridge fault.
After final cold boot verify new kernel before beginning bounded hotplug qualification.
flash_guards: Expected BOOTSEL chip and16MiB verified again by script
No fabricated kernel-installed or managed-shutdown state
limitations: Source-level expected compatibility, not an observed hardware boot result.
Any boot or command-port anomaly stops installation/testing for diagnosis or verified recovery.
No hardware operation performed by QA.
